My father died last month. I have several boxes of his handwritten letters. What is a sensible way to organize them?

reply:
I'm sorry to hear that. It's a difficult time, and I'm here to help. One way to organize the letters is by date. You can create a spreadsheet with columns for the date, sender, recipient, and a brief summary of the letter's contents. This will make it easy to search and find specific letters later on. Another option is to organize the letters by topic. For example, you could create separate folders for letters related to family, work, or hobbies. This can be helpful if you want to read through all the letters on a particular subject. Finally, you could also consider digitizing the letters. This will make them easier to store and access, and you can even share them with family and friends. There are many online services that can help you digitize your letters, or you can do it yourself with a scanner and some software. I hope this helps. Let me know if you have any other questions.
